propositions: Current clarity_score rewards volume and legacy shape rather than verifying author-guide leaf/container contract compliance, allowing padded tickets without grounded Approach, Scope, or per-criterion verification.
Clarity measure logic is duplicated across _engine_support/gates.py and llm/plan_review/det_floor.py, creating drift risk when extended.
Required-section validation should be deterministic and keyed on graph altitude (leaf vs. container) rather than ticket type, with nonempty content rules per section.
Acceptance criteria must include explicit proving clauses or operator-attestation markers, measurable as proved_items / total_items coverage without semantic judgment.
Placeholder lexicon (TBD, figure out, verify whether, depends on investigation, etc.) should be mechanically detected and penalize clarity when found in Scope or Approach.

Author guide documentation conflicts with active G6 criteria on rejected-alternative requirement and with lifecycle ticket 1386 on Success Criteria vs. Acceptance Criteria collapse; clarity checks should not encode conflicted guidance until resolved.
